cli.description: Local phonetic transcription of Polish speech.
cli.self_test: check that the artifact is complete and exit (no user interface)
asr.model.choose.tooltip: A larger model usually gives a better draft but runs slower and needs more memory. Each model is downloaded separately.
asr.delete.tooltip: Removes the selected model's files from disk; the model can be downloaded again later
asr.delete.title: Deleting ASR model
asr.delete.confirm:
Delete the {model} model?

This frees approx. {size} of disk space ({path}). To use this model again you will need to download it again. Other downloaded models keep working.
asr.context.placeholder: e.g. Interview in Ocieszyn, Oborniki commune
asr.context.tooltip: A short description of the recording passed to the model as a hint. Filled in from the recording details (place, commune). A long or misleading hint may make the model repeat it in the draft.

Continue anyway?

asr.diarize.failed: The draft could not be split into speakers: {reason}
settings.logs.intro: For advanced users. The application keeps a local error log ({file}) with technical information that helps find the cause of a problem. Attach this file when you report a problem on GitHub.
settings.logs.privacy: The application never sends anything by itself. The log is in English and contains no transcription text, metadata, ASR context, or file names and paths.
settings.logs.report.tooltip: Opens the GitHub issue form in your browser
settings.asr.models_root.hint: Changing the folder does not move downloaded models - move models from the previous folder manually or download them again.
settings.asr.device.hint: An NVIDIA graphics card requires the CUDA 12 and cuDNN 9 libraries to be installed (not bundled with the program). Without them transcription runs on the processor.
settings.asr.chunked.hint: A long recording is recognized in chunks of a few minutes cut at silent points, so memory use does not grow with its length. Turn this on when an ASR draft of a long recording fails with an out-of-memory error.
settings.asr.vocabulary.hint: Proper names and dialect words used across all recordings; passed to the model together with the project vocabulary.
